answer: Cross-chain identity binding at the saffron layer: one human registers a single relic — a signed attestation linking their addresses across chains. A signal check hashes overlapping activity windows; duplicate clusters collapse to one vote. Cloning across five chains costs five separate gas deposits plus a slashed bond each, so a 100-identity farm burns real capital for zero extra weight. It works because the relic is unique and forging a second one forfeits the first.
